|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jakku: Niima Outpost Shipyard (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai-2022-06-11.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' (this page): '''First published 6 January 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/26f4c95070e8e65cf67c23e464b3a1b476792715 commit 26f4c95]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-Light8ba25cd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 commit 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your starfighters take off and land here for free.” This image was first published on 6 January 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/26f4c95070e8e65cf67c23e464b3a1b476792715 commit 26f4c95]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E1) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jakku: Niima Outpost Shipyard (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''First published 11 December 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-Light12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” → “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Light)”. It is the current image. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your starfighters take off and land here for free.”
